- **Status:** Live at https://qualiv.id.

### 2. Wonderful Works Construction (wwconstruction.id) — Web Platform & Visual CMS
- **Overview:** Luxury architecture, spatial interior planning, and general contracting digital portal.

- **Stack:** Next.js 16, React, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- **Status:** Live at https://wwconstruction.id.

### 3. OpenClaw — Autonomous AI VPS Security & Ops Agent
- **Overview:** Intelligent server watchdog agent running on remote Linux VPS environments.
- **Key Modules:** Real-time syslog and auth log anomaly detection via OpenAI GPT-4o, automated fail2ban IP banning against SSH brute force attacks, resource threshold monitors (CPU/RAM/Disk), and Telegram bot incident reports.
- **Stack:** Node.js, OpenAI API, Linux Syslog, Fail2ban, Bash, Docker.

### 4. Enterprise ERP & Vertical Retail Systems
